title: Literally the worst towels ever
text: Literally the worst towels ever. Oh please, if someone will read my review so I can save them from the horror of these “towels”…. Where to begin. First of all, they’re tiny. Maybe appropriate size towel for a 6 year old. Second, they are not absorbent at all. Honestly I felt like I shouldn’t even bother trying to dry off because it was about as effective as rubbing printer paper on my skin. And then, to make things worse, even after a dozen washes, these towels left little black fuzz bits all over my skin. I took a shower to be clean and now I’m covered in lint and fuzz. Oh and also, they fell apart within a week. Frayed ends, long loose threads- just a disaster. My mental health declined after buying these towels. Save yourselves.
